# Economic forecast: economic-forecast (FCST)

The IMF World Economic Outlook: growth, inflation, unemployment, external balance and debt, outturn and projections to 2031. One row per economic forecast, keyed by FORECAST_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `macro-store` (table `<root>/macro/economic-forecast/`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/world-economy/samples/economic-forecast.jsonl`, 192 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/world-economy/samples/economic-forecast.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `FORECAST_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

## One sample record

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FORECAST_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^FCST-` | `"FCST-ABW-WEO"` |
| `ECONOMY_NAME` | string | required | The country or territory the figures describe. | — | `"Aruba"` |
| `VINTAGE` | string | required | The IMF World Economic Outlook edition the figures come from; the IMF revises them twice a year. | — | `"IMF World Economic Outlook, April 2026 edition"` |
| `GROWTH_2027` | number | optional (filled in 98% of rows) | The IMF projection of real GDP growth in 2027. | seen: `2`, `3`, `4`, `1`, `5`, `6`; unit: % a year | `2` |
| `INFLATION_2027` | number | optional (filled in 98% of rows) | The IMF projection of average consumer-price inflation in 2027. | unit: % a year | `2` |
| `DEBT_2030` | number | optional (filled in 95% of rows) | The IMF projection of general government gross debt as a share of GDP in 2030. | unit: % of GDP | `50.3` |
| `PROJECTIONS` | array of objects | required | The IMF World Economic Outlook series by year, outturn then projection, one element per year: YEAR, BASIS (outturn or projection), GROWTH (NGDP_RPCH), INFLATION (PCPIPCH), UNEMPLOYMENT (LUR), CURRENT_ACCOUNT (BCA_NGDPD), DEBT (GGXWDG_NGDP), NET_LENDING (GGXCNL_NGDP) and GDP (NGDPD). | — | [17 objects] |
| `PROJECTIONS[].YEAR` | string | required | The calendar year of the values, as four-digit text ("2015"). | — | `"2015"` |
| `PROJECTIONS[].GROWTH` | number | required | Yearly change of real GDP. | unit: % a year | `3.6` |
| `PROJECTIONS[].INFLATION` | number | optional (filled in over 99% of `PROJECTIONS[]` entries) | Average consumer-price inflation in that year (IMF WEO PCPIPCH), in percent a year (0.5 is 0.5%). | unit: % a year | `0.5` |
| `PROJECTIONS[].UNEMPLOYMENT` | number | optional (filled in 56% of `PROJECTIONS[]` entries) | Share of the labour force without a job. | unit: % of labour force | `7.3` |
| `PROJECTIONS[].CURRENT_ACCOUNT` | number | optional (filled in over 99% of `PROJECTIONS[]` entries) | Balance of trade, income and transfers with the rest of the world. | unit: % of GDP | `3.9` |
| `PROJECTIONS[].DEBT` | number | optional (filled in 98% of `PROJECTIONS[]` entries) | General government gross debt. | unit: % of GDP | `74.2` |
| `PROJECTIONS[].NET_LENDING` | number | optional (filled in over 99% of `PROJECTIONS[]` entries) | General government revenue minus expenditure. | unit: % of GDP | `-1.5` |
| `PROJECTIONS[].GDP` | number | optional (filled in over 99% of `PROJECTIONS[]` entries) | GDP in current US dollars. | unit: USD billions | `2.963` |
| `PROJECTIONS[].BASIS` | string | required | Projection for years from the vintage year on, otherwise outturn or estimate. | one of `Outturn or estimate`, `Projection` | `"Outturn or estimate"` |
| `PATH` | array of objects | required | Real GDP growth by year, outturn then projection, one element per year: YEAR and GROWTH in % a year (IMF NGDP_RPCH). | — | [17 objects] |
| `PATH[].YEAR` | string | required | The calendar year of the value, as four-digit text ("2015"). | — | `"2015"` |
| `PATH[].GROWTH` | number | required | Yearly change of real GDP, outturn then projection. | unit: % a year | `3.6` |
| `ECONOMY` | string | required | The economy forecast: an id of the economy kind (ECON-<ISO 3166-1 alpha-3>). | pattern `^ECON-`; links to `economy` | `"ECON-ABW"` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (IMF World Economic Outlook, DataMapper), DATASET (the WEO edition), RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION and URL. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The organisation or organisations whose published data this view shows. | — | `"International Monetary Fund, World Economic Outlook (DataM…` |
| `PROVENANCE.DATASET` | string | required | The named dataset and its vintage (the release the numbers come from). | — | `"World Economic Outlook (April 2026 edition)"` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the data was downloaded by tools/realdata. | — | `"2026-10-10"` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The terms under which the source allows reuse; attribution is required. | — | `"IMF Copyright and Terms of Use: reuse with attribution; co…` |
| `PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTION` | string | required | The credit line to repeat when the data is shown or republished. | — | `"Source: International Monetary Fund, World Economic Outloo…` |
| `PROVENANCE.URL` | string | required | The web page of the dataset. | — | `"https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper"` |
| `_meta` | object | optional (filled in every row) | The generator's provenance stamp, one object; optional, carried through in the stored document and not read by Drishti (the contracts leave it out). A bank's extract may omit it. | — | {…} |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 192 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `FORECAST_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `FORECAST_ID`, `ECONOMY_NAME`, `VINTAGE`, `PROJECTIONS`, `PATH`, `ECONOMY`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `FORECAST_ID` per snapshot.
- `FORECAST_ID` matches `^FCST-`.
